question: Can a grandfather's inheritance pass to a daughter-in-law through his son?
premises: Inheritance may come from the grandfather.
The grandfather's son is an intermediary.
The daughter-in-law is the son's wife.
inference: Inheritance from the grandfather may pass to the daughter-in-law through his son.
plain_english: Inheritance coming from the grandfather should pass to the daughter-in-law through his son.
